standard.summary: oom_only 仅在 OOM 恢复时释放
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.off: 不主动清缓存，峰值看着虚高，同步少。
optionDescriptions.oom_only: 只有 OOM 救火时才清。
optionDescriptions.aggressive: 阶段和步进后都清，峰值低，抖和同步也多。

standard_en.summary: oom_only releases only while recovering from an OOM
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.off: Never clears the cache; the peak looks inflated but there are fewer synchronisations.
optionDescriptions.oom_only: Clears only when firefighting an OOM.
optionDescriptions.phase_boundary: Clears when switching between the TE and VAE phases.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Clears after both phases and steps: the lowest peak, with more jitter and more synchronisation.

advanced.principle: oom_only 仅在 OOM 恢复时释放；phase_boundary 在 TE/VAE / 组件下 CPU 边界释放；after_optimizer 保留旧低显存稳妥档；aggressive 会把阶段边界和训练步释放都打开。旧 every_step 配置会自动按 aggressive 兼容。

advanced_en.principle: oom_only releases only during OOM recovery; phase_boundary releases at TE/VAE / component-to-CPU boundaries; after_optimizer keeps the old conservative low-VRAM tier; aggressive turns on both phase-boundary and per-training-step releases. Legacy every_step configs are auto-mapped to aggressive.
